title: Glowing alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='32' fill='#5A6B8C' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='30' fill='#7BA0D6' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='26' fill='#2E3E5E' />

  <!-- clock face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='23' fill='#1B2640' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='21' fill='#F5E6A8' />

  <!-- hour markers -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='34' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#D4A020' />
  <rect x='48.5' y='69' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#D4A020' />
  <rect x='29' y='52.5' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#D4A020' />
  <rect x='66' y='52.5' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#D4A020' />

  <!-- clock hands -->
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='50' y2='40' stroke='#D04030' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' />
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='62' y2='58' stroke='#D04030' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#D04030' />

  <!-- bells -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='24' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#C08020' />
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='22' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#F0C050' />
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='24' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#C08020' />
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='22' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#F0C050' />

  <!-- hammer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='3' fill='#E08030' />

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='84' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8C9EBF' />
  <rect x='65' y='84' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8C9EBF' />

  <!-- glow effect -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#FFEB80' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.4' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='38' fill='none' stroke='#FFEB80' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.2' />
</svg>
